title: Mealy+Moore FSM (3 architectures: rtla/rtlb/rtlc; TB instantiates all three)
problemDescription: 3-state FSM with both Moore (depends on state) and Mealy (depends on state + input) outputs. States S0/S1/S2; transitions on a + b. Reference has 3 architectures (3-process, 2-process, 1-process); the TB instantiates all three.
